dedupe_keys.name: nationwide annual agricultural land use maps of germany 1990 2023 landsat and sentinel 2

description: This dataset gives annual agricultural land use maps of Germany for 1990 to 2023 from Landsat and Sentinel-2 time series with a deep learning method. The Zenodo record says each map has 14 classes, such as winter and summer cereals, maize, grassland, potato, sugar beet, rapeseed, legumes, fallow, vineyards and hops, as 34 cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs with matching clear-sky observation maps and English and German colour tables. It was published in June 2026 (version 1.01) by researchers at the Johann Heinrich von Thünen-Institut and Universität Greifswald under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 14.7 GB. Coverage is Germany. Caveats: the paper was under review, and early years with few clear observations are less reliable, as the observation maps show. For simulation it gives three decades of crop patterns to model drought and flood exposure trends of German agriculture. Related catalogue records include the national crop type maps for Germany 2017 to 2019 and the harmonized IACS inventory.
